name: rocx
description: Highlighting for .rocx files (Roc with markup, CSS in <style>), and rocx dev's errors as problems at your .rocx lines.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In restricted mode only highlighting works: the rocx tasks run the workspace's rocx, which builds and runs its code.

dir.description: The app's directory (the one with routes/ in it), relative to the workspace folder: the task runs `rocx dev <dir>`.

check.description: Run `rocx check <dir>` once instead of `rocx dev`: rocx build, then the app's server and browser programs type-checked, from its sources.

args.description: More arguments for `rocx dev` (`--port`, `8081`; after `--`, the server's own).

command.description: A command line to run instead of `rocx dev` (`just dev`, `just check`), in the workspace folder; what rocx and the compiler report through it becomes problems too.

rocx.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `rocx` executable (`~` is expanded). Empty: `bin/rocx` in the workspace folder when there is one (the rocx repository's own), else `rocx` from `PATH`.
